mapper.sql: select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Start_Time as secStartTime, sec.Sec_Bidding_Cycle as secBiddingCycle, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Other_Valuation as secOtherValuation, sec.Sec_Pricing_Method as secPricingMethod, sec.Sec_Trading_Place as secTradingPlace, sec.Sec_Money as secMoney, sec.Sec_Contracting_department as secContractingDepartment, c4.C_Name as tendereeName, c6.C_Name as secAgencyName, ws.* from Sec_Work_Schema_Inquiry_Doc ws left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=ws.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c4 on c4.C_ID=sec.Sec_Tenderee left join Sys_Company c6 on c6.C_Id=sec.Sec_Agency
